name: body
label: Introduction
default: Have a question about your property? Let’s talk it through.

default.question: What is GraceSoft Easy InnKeeping?
default.answer: Easy InnKeeping is GraceSoft’s hospitality property management software. It helps lodging teams manage reservations, front desk work and guest information, with connected products for bookings, distribution, payments and communication.

default.question: What types of properties does it support?
default.answer: GraceSoft describes solutions for hotels, motels, inns, bed and breakfasts, resorts, vacation rentals, campgrounds, condos, guest ranches and multi-property businesses. Discuss your specific property and workflow during a demo.

default.question: Is Easy InnKeeping cloud-based?
default.answer: GraceSoft offers cloud-based property management software. Confirm device, connectivity and access requirements for your team’s setup.

default.question: Can I manage more than one property?
default.answer: GraceSoft offers multi-property management options. Ask which portfolio workflows, permissions and reporting features are available for your configuration.

default.question: Can guests book directly through my website?
default.answer: The GraceSoft online booking engine provides a direct booking option for your property website. Ask how it connects to your website, inventory and chosen payment setup.

default.question: Which booking channels can I connect?
default.answer: Channel Manager connects to supported online travel agency channels. Check the current channel list with GraceSoft and confirm connection mode, plan and regional availability for your property.

default.question: What payment and housekeeping tools are available?
default.answer: GraceSoft describes payment processing, billing and housekeeping capabilities. Available gateways, room-status workflows and task options depend on your plan and configuration.

default.question: Are AI voice, chat and guest messaging available?
default.answer: GraceSoft offers AI voice and chat options alongside guest communication products. Ask about supported channels, availability, setup and how inquiries connect to your reservation workflow.

default.question: What support is available?
default.answer: Ask GraceSoft about onboarding, training, support channels and service hours for your plan. Existing customers can use the GraceSoft Support Center.

default.question: How can I see a demo and understand pricing?
default.answer: Use Book a demo to visit GraceSoft’s existing demo request page. You can also view the pricing page and discuss the products, integrations and setup your property needs.
